migration.title: Migrate history from v1
migration.description: Offline import of legacy UniClipboard history, files, and tags
migration.readyBody: History, tags and trust settings stay on this device. Select a folder to import a v1 backup.
migration.detectedTitle: Clipboard history is ready to import
migration.detectedBody: Import v1 text, images, files and tags offline. The system clipboard stays the same during import.
migration.invalid: No valid v1 data in this folder
migration.invalidBody: Choose a backup folder containing the v1 database and vault/keyslot.json.
migration.unlockBody: The v1 key could not be read. The app uses the passphrase for local decryption.
migration.stoppingBody: Saved records are kept and skipped when you resume.
migration.verifyingBody: Checking records, tags and colors. Keep the app in the foreground.
migration.importingBody: Decrypting and importing history offline. Keep the app in the foreground.
migration.doneBody: V1 clipboard history was imported and verified on this device.
migration.partial: Some records could not be imported
migration.partialBody: Saved records are kept. Retry the remaining items or open history.
migration.stoppedBody: Saved records: {{count}}. Resuming skips these records.
migration.conflict: The data folder is in use
migration.conflictBody: Close the task using the data folder, then try again.
migration.failedBody: Check access to the backup folder, then try again.
migration.skipBody: V1 data is kept. Start migration later from Settings › Storage.
migration.unlockFailed: Could not unlock the v1 credentials. Enter the passphrase again.
